question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Abundant
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e., 'Sparse'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Abundant"** means existing or available in large quantities; plentiful. (प्रचुर मात्रा में)

 
 
• **Example:** The harvest was abundant this year, resulting in plenty of food for everyone.
 
 
 
• **"Sparse"** refers to something that is thinly dispersed or scattered; not dense. (विरल)
 
 
• **Example:** Vegetation becomes sparse as you move towards the desert.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **'abundant'** is **'sparse'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Sparse**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Plentiful** (प्रचुर): Existing in great quantities.

 
 
• **Example:** During the spring, flowers are plentiful in this region.
 
 
 
• **Ample** (पर्याप्त): Enough or more than enough; plentiful.
 
 
• **Example:** There was ample evidence to support the claim.
 
 
 
• **Copious** (प्रचुर): Abundant in supply or quantity.
 
 
• **Example:** The author provided copious details about the historical event.
